build_PyramidVisionTransformer: build a PyramidVisionTransformer backbone model with configurable stages, heads, and spatial reduction ratios for dense prediction tasks
build_PyramidVisionTransformerV2: build a PyramidVisionTransformerV2 backbone with larger patch sizes, no absolute position embedding, and convolutional FFN enabled
create_SpatialReductionAttention: create a SpatialReductionAttention module that reduces key/value spatial resolution by a configurable ratio before multihead attention
create_MixFFN: create a MixFFN feedforward network using 1x1 convolutions with optional 3x3 depthwise conv for positional encoding
create_PVTEncoderLayer: create a PVTEncoderLayer combining SpatialReductionAttention and MixFFN with layer normalization and dropout for transformer encoding
